decision_scope: Release only the existing frozen rev003 SCORE evaluation in the same experimental round; this is not a scientific success or failure determination.

verified_closure.FIT_VALID_split_reconstruction: Exact 120 FIT and 40 VALID prompt IDs; actual job sets match the frozen hash ordering.
verified_closure.capture: Both models, both selected layers, every retained prefill token and exactly eight decode steps per job; row indices, extents, top-K IDs and alpha metadata close.
verified_closure.first_FIT_no_callback_controls: Both models pass identical retained tokens, eight generated tokens and nine full-vocabulary logit-array hashes.
verified_closure.operator_selection: All eight expert selections exactly reconstruct from FIT-only route counts and frozen tie rules.
verified_closure.comparison_reconstruction: Every VALID-only cost-eligible control choice and comparison ID matches the frozen list; no finite-local candidate lacks an eligible control.
verified_closure.inconclusive_closure: C1 selected lambda-infinity endpoints explain incomplete composites; best-finite points remain preserved.

required_interpretation: Keep the complete frozen comparison family unchanged, including undefined or inconclusive bootstrap results.
Recheck the same VALID-frozen matched control against actual SCORE costs; do not select replacement controls from SCORE.
All primary 80-to-120 FIT learning curves still improve; a negative SCORE result cannot automatically count as a family failure.
Nominal leaf occupancy does not prove full numerical rank, good conditioning or statistical power.
Local operator MSE is not whole-model quality or latency; C1-only improvement does not establish conditional-bank necessity.
